items.title: File Widerspruch against denial of orthopedic insole cost coverage
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 14 Apr 2025, sent by a social-law body (Krankenkasse) so § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X applies: it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting = Fri 18 Apr 2025 (this day does not shift even though it is Karfreitag, a public holiday, per SGB X delivery rule). Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period starts the next day; per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB it ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. Sun 18 May 2025. Since that is a Sunday, § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X shifts the deadline to the next working day: Mon 19 May 2025.
